answer: On first task submission, require a provider-signed inference receipt containing a fresh nonce and billable call ID; the payout gateway verifies the signature and rejects reused IDs, so every extra key must pay for another real model call. A catalog task could identify pigment on a walnut relic. Proposed receipt fee: $0.02 per identity × 1,000 = $20, versus a proposed $0.02 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: a well-funded operator can buy many calls, and receipts prove compute, not distinct ownership.
